answer_1.quote: We propose AdaQR, a preference optimization approach for enhancing query rewriter... Query rewriting is instrumental in clarifying users' search intents during information‑seeking conversations, improving the retrieval of relevant passages.

answer_2.quote: We assess retrieval performance using several metrics: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) calculates the average rank of gold passages. Normalized Discounted Cumulative@3 (NDCG) evaluates the top-3 retrieval results... Recall@k reflects whether the retriever successfully identifies the gold passages within top‑k results.
